record.capability: Original public UNO environment resolved-pointer value ownership
assertions: Preserve original Environment resolved-pointer/copy/move acquisition, release, publication and equality-skipping assignment through actual C callbacks.
Preserve acquired exact type-name values and borrowed context identity without pointer/address inference.
Compare every initialized ownership/accessor stream byte against normal and ASan/UBSan originals using actual DefaultEnvironment strong/weak callbacks.
gaps: Descriptor/current lookup and invocation/purpose stack methods are not implemented by this value-owner slice.

Upstream Embind BridgeTest is contextual consuming environment/mapping QA, not a direct portable QA port; full environment/bridge/application bootstrap and physical ABI/allocator/concurrency/noexcept/leak/full consumer QA remain unverified.

docs.marker: C++ wrapper for binary C uno_Environment.

stackDivergence.rationale: Original public uno::Environment resolved-pointer/default/copy/move ownership, pointer/copy/move assignment, destruction, clear/get/is and owned getTypeName/borrowed getContext accessors. Actual C environment callbacks and OUString owners are reused. Pointer/copy assignment skips identical pointers; differing pointers acquire new before releasing old and publishing. Clear releases before null publication; self-move releases and clears. Type-name returns own exact Unicode/NUL descriptor references, while context is passed through without address synthesis or identity conversion. Whole original environment.hxx plus unchanged lbenv.cxx and real DefaultEnvironment callbacks supply complete normal-ASan/UBSan identical ownership/accessor streams. Enclosing input records are not production environment constructors/providers. Descriptor/current lookup, invoke/enter/isValid purpose-stack APIs, public bootstrap/application installation, physical ABI/allocator/concurrency/noexcept termination/leaks and full upstream consumer QA remain incomplete or unverified.
